input.query: social login google existing user email provider update

candidates.explanation: When no user matches the social id and a user exists with the same email, the code overwrites user.provider and user.socialId whenever the user is not inactive. An active, confirmed email/password account therefore gets linked and converted to the social provider (provider becomes 'google'). validateLogin then rejects email login because user.provider !== 'email'. The condition only excludes inactive users, which is inverted or insufficient. It should not modify an existing active account of a different provider.

fix.description: In the `else if (userByEmail)` branch, do not overwrite provider or socialId on an existing active account. Either reject the social login with an error such as emailAlreadyExists, or sign the user in without changing provider and socialId. Only touch accounts that are not already active, for example inactive accounts that were never confirmed, and do so deliberately. Do not call update on an active email account.
